verdict.rationale: New Relic's own alerting lets users define rules: NRQL-based conditions and thresholds on any signal, with notifications that route issues to systems or teams. Its vulnerability agent can also automatically open Jira tickets or GitHub issues that trigger a coding agent. However, the documented actions are mainly notification and routing, and the evidence shows no general event-to-action rule engine. missing for 10: documented general-purpose automated actions or workflows beyond notifications, detail on how remediation automation is configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.
Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.
Route issues to the correct system or team using notifications.
can open a Jira ticket or GitHub issue in the affected repository — triggering a coding agent you already use (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or a custom agent) to initiate a fix
